opening.argument: The video demonstrates a concrete production workflow: finding rain media through a Creative Commons filter, copying audio and video elements in an editor, and uploading the finished video to YouTube. The earnings examples are qualified as atypical, and the description says results are not guaranteed. The speaker also promotes an affiliate program, disclosing that it costs $7 to start and asking viewers to enter an email address through the description link. That promotion does not erase the instructional purpose of the video, and the available evidence does not establish deceptive conduct.
